newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's August home appliance sales up 21.17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's August home appliance sales up 21.17 pct.

text.p: The volume of Brazilian home appliance sales jumped 21.17 percent in August 1996 versus the same month last year, home appliance makers association Eletros said Thursday.
Sales have shot up due to a lengthening the maturity of installments, drops in interest rates and a "favorable" trend in home appliance prices, Eletros said in a statement.
August sales, in terms of units sold, also rose 4.03 percent against July, it said. In the first eight months of 1996, home appliance sales have risen 31.77 percent over the same period last year.

Eletros added that white goods sales rose 30.04 percent against August 1995, noting that production of vertical freezers, ovens and automatic washing machines reached a record monthly high last month.
August stereo sales rose 18.33 percent and portable appliance sales dropped 2.14 percent when compared to the same month last year, it added.
